♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon has just shifted from Aquarius into early Pisces in Purva Bhadrapada, moving through your 12th house while ruled by Jupiter sitting in Cancer in your 4th. This quietly dilutes yesterday’s social focus and pulls you inward, toward rest, dreams and emotional cleansing. The Sun and retrograde Mercury continue in sidereal Virgo in your 6th, but are now moving closer to Ketu by sign, sharpening your awareness of what no longer belongs in your daily routines. Mars, your ruler, is still in late Cancer in your 4th, forming a subtle trine to the Pisces Moon: home, family, and inner security remain the stage on which your energy plays out. This is a day for soft but decisive inner reorganisation.

💼 Career: With a 12th-house Moon, your best professional moves are more background than spotlight. Editing, preparing, quietly closing loops, and tying up loose ends will be more productive than launching bold new initiatives. Sun–Mercury retrograde in Virgo in your 6th still highlight processes, co-workers and systems, but today the emphasis is on what you can remove rather than what you add: redundant tasks, over-complicated reporting, or responsibilities you’ve outgrown. You may not feel like talking much; allow your work quality to speak for you.

❤️ Love: Pisces Moon can make your heart extra sensitive, but also more compassionate. If partnered, you might realise where you’ve been reacting from old family patterns rather than from the current situation. A private, unhurried conversation at home—possibly in the evening—can help both of you release recent tension. If single, you could feel nostalgic about past relationships or strangely drawn to someone who feels emotionally familiar. Just remember: today is better for understanding your patterns than for defining a future with anyone.

💰 Money: The Virgo emphasis in your 6th still supports careful budgeting around everyday expenses—subscriptions, commuting, small work-related costs. But with the Moon in the 12th, it’s wise to look at subtle leaks: purchases made when you’re exhausted, charity or support given out of guilt, or automatic payments you’ve stopped using. Mars in your 4th can bring spending related to home and family; choose upgrades that genuinely provide comfort, not just momentary distraction.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to move more slowly and to be less available. This is a good day to let certain chapters in your habits and your emotional life quietly close.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: What you finally allow yourself to release in private today makes more room than any external achievement could.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon in early Pisces lights up your 11th house of community, long-term aspirations and gains, ruled by Jupiter in Cancer in your 3rd. Your mind is receptive to big ideas and subtle signals from your networks. The Sun and retrograde Mercury continue in Virgo in your 5th, still encouraging review of creative projects, children’s matters and the risks you take for joy—but today the energy is less about polishing your performance and more about seeing where your talents can serve a wider circle. Venus, your ruler, remains in Libra in your 6th, keeping you attuned to balance in work and health.

💼 Career: With the Moon in your 11th, conversations with colleagues, clients and communities may reveal new possibilities. Pay attention to offhand comments about upcoming roles, collaborative ventures or emerging needs—these can hint at future opportunities. The Virgo cluster in your 5th house is ideal for revisiting a proposal, training, or creative concept that has career potential: a course you might teach, content you could release, or a specialised service you could refine. Today is more about mapping the ecosystem around your work than forcing a concrete outcome.

❤️ Love: Your focus leans toward how romance fits into your wider life vision. If partnered, you may naturally talk about shared goals—future projects, travel, or how to support each other’s creative paths. There’s a subtle blend of friendship and affection that can feel especially nourishing. If single, you’re more likely to be drawn to someone who’s already in your orbit through groups, online communities or mutual causes. The attraction grows when you see that their values and dreams actually complement yours.

💰 Money: Pisces in the 11th can bring intuitive awareness around gains from your efforts—bonuses, commissions, side income or client referrals. Even if nothing concrete lands today, you may sense which alliances are quietly growing in value and which ones are fading. Virgo in your 5th suggests a review of spending related to hobbies, children and pleasure. Instead of cutting joy, you may find yourself channelling funds into fewer, better experiences or tools that could also support income down the line.

🧘 Advice: Let your imagination roam beyond the present layout of your life, but keep one eye on what can realistically be nurtured over time.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The dream you dare to say out loud to the right person today may start turning from fantasy into a plan.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves into Pisces at the very top of your chart, activating your 10th house of karma, vocation and public standing, ruled by Jupiter in Cancer in your 2nd. Your sensitivity and intuition now colour how others see you. The Sun and your ruler, retrograde Mercury, continue in Virgo in your 4th, still prompting review of home, family and inner foundations—but today the sky highlights how those private adjustments are beginning to show in your professional presence. This is a day when subtle shifts in your inner security can translate into outer credibility.

💼 Career: A 10th-house Moon often coincides with attention from superiors, clients or the public, and with Pisces there, people feel your sincerity more than your cleverness. It’s a good day to present ideas with a human angle, to show empathy in leadership, or to handle a delicate situation at work. Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 4th keep domestic questions in the background—perhaps you’re reconsidering where you work from, how you structure your time around family, or whether your base supports your ambitions. Decisions taken now about your foundations will influence the roles you’re offered later.

❤️ Love: The balance between private life and outer responsibilities is in focus. If partnered, you may need to explain a work commitment or career pressure that’s affecting your mood or availability. Honest, gentle sharing can prevent misunderstandings. If single, you might notice attraction in professional settings or with someone who recognises and respects your ambitions. You’re drawn to people who understand that your inner world is complex, even if you appear adaptable to others.

💰 Money: With Jupiter ruling today’s Moon from your 2nd house, financial themes tie into reputation. You may think about how your earning methods reflect your values, or how much you’re willing to invest in training, branding or tools that support your vocation. The Virgo emphasis in your 4th suggests revisiting home-related costs or family financial agreements; a small reorganisation of these can free you up to focus more calmly on your career path.

🧘 Advice: Show up as the most integrated version of yourself you can manage—professional but not armoured, competent yet still human.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you choose to handle one public responsibility today can quietly redefine how people picture you for months to come.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

The Sun and retrograde Mercury continue in Virgo in your 3rd, sharpening your attention to details in communication, learning and local matters. Mars still in your sign adds drive and occasional impatience. Today, the sky supports stepping back from small irritations to realign with a bigger sense of purpose.

💼 Career: The 9th house favours activities tied to teaching, training, publishing, law, academia and cross-cultural projects. You may feel a nudge to explore a course, certification, or new field that could expand your professional options. Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 3rd encourage review of how you share information: emails, reports, presentations, or even your social media voice. It’s an excellent day to refine a document, prepare material for a workshop, or reconsider your daily commute or workflow to make space for growth.

❤️ Love: Pisces Moon softens your emotional edges and makes you more reflective about relationship patterns. If partnered, conversations may naturally turn toward meaning—why you’re together, what you’re building, or how your beliefs intersect. Travel plans, study, or spiritual practices shared as a couple can feel especially bonding. If single, you could feel drawn to someone from a different background or someone you meet in study, spiritual or travel-related environments. What matters now is alignment of vision more than instant chemistry.

💰 Money: With Jupiter active in your 1st and ruling your 9th, you may think in broader terms about finances—investments in education, relocation, or long-term projects rather than just short-term gains. Virgo in your 3rd highlights everyday expenses linked to transport, communication and skills training. Adjusting one of these—perhaps choosing a more efficient route, tool or class—could create more room for the bigger plans that are calling you.

🧘 Advice: Let your current questions about work and relationships be guided by the deeper question: “What kind of life story am I trying to live?”

⚡ Mauksh Truth: A single perspective you gain today—through a book, a talk or a conversation—could quietly reshape your direction more than any dramatic event.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon enters Pisces and your 8th house of shared resources, emotional entanglements and deep transformation, ruled by Jupiter in Cancer in your 12th. This pulls your fiery nature into more introspective waters. The Sun, your ruler, remains in Virgo in your 2nd along with retrograde Mercury, keeping your mind on income, values and practical choices. Today, the contrast is strong: worldly questions of security meet subtle shifts in how you share power, time and feelings with others.

💼 Career: The 8th-house Moon favours work involving research, strategy, behind-the-scenes problem solving and anything dealing with other people’s money—joint ventures, company budgets, insurance, tax, or investments. You may notice an unspoken dynamic in your workplace: who actually holds influence, who quietly supports whom, where trust is strong and where it’s thin. Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 2nd are ideal for reviewing pricing, salary structure or the way your role is defined. This isn’t about proving yourself; it’s about ensuring that what you give and what you receive are in reasonable proportion.

❤️ Love: Today’s Moon stirs vulnerability, but also the possibility of deeper intimacy if you’re willing to be honest. If partnered, themes around merging—finances, space, emotional labour—may come into focus. Rather than dramatising inequalities, try naming what would help you feel more supported and asking what your partner needs in return. If single, you may feel drawn to intense, mysterious people or to someone who seems to “see through” you. Take your time; use this energy to better understand your own fears and desires before promising more than you’re ready to live.

💰 Money: Virgo in your 2nd keeps the spotlight on accounts, budgets and tangible assets, while Pisces Moon in the 8th highlights shared or hidden money—debts, taxes, partner’s income, or family resources. You may sense where a financial arrangement is a bit foggy. Today is useful for gently clarifying terms, consolidating, or beginning to design a more transparent system. Avoid big impulsive moves; instead, collect information and let your intuition and facts meet.

🧘 Advice: Courage for you today is less about a grand gesture and more about letting yourself look steadily at what you usually keep in the shadows.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The honest feeling you’re willing to name around give-and-take today can become the key to a more sustainable kind of closeness.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in early Pisces activates your 7th house of partnerships, contracts and one-to-one exchanges, ruled by Jupiter in Cancer in your 11th. Other people’s moods and needs colour your day more than usual. Meanwhile, the Sun and your ruler, retrograde Mercury, continue in your own sign in the 1st, keeping you in an extended phase of self-review and adjustment. Today’s transits invite you to see how the version of you that’s emerging interacts differently with partners, clients and close allies.

💼 Career: With the Moon in your 7th, negotiations, client meetings, and collaborative work take centre stage. You may be asked to mediate, clarify, or bring order to a situation where expectations are blurry. Your Virgo planets in the 1st give you extra discernment, but Pisces energy asks you to combine clarity with kindness. It’s a strong day to revisit partnership terms, role definitions or service agreements, especially where you’ve been holding more responsibility than is visible on paper.

❤️ Love: Relationships are highlighted in a fluid, somewhat emotional way. If partnered, you may feel your partner’s sensitivities more acutely; this can be a chance to respond with empathy without losing your own boundaries. Conversations about how you each support one another’s goals and friendships could be fruitful. If single, you’re drawn to compassionate, imaginative types or to someone within your wider circle of friends and communities. Trust what you observe about how people treat others, not just how they speak to you.

💰 Money: Pisces Moon in the 7th points to shared finances—how bills are split, how you price collaborative work, or how you handle client payments. Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 1st help you see where your own habits contribute to confusion: under-quoting, over-delivering, or avoiding difficult financial conversations. Today is supportive for gentle, factual discussions about numbers and expectations, especially if you approach them as fine-tuning rather than confrontation.

🧘 Advice: Let your desire for precision be guided by goodwill. You’re not tightening the screws on people; you’re trying to create arrangements that allow everyone to breathe.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The boundary you calmly redraw around a partnership today may become the reason that connection can actually last.
libra:

scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces lights up your 5th house of creativity, children, romance and self-expression, ruled by Jupiter in Cancer in your 9th. This brings a more imaginative, even philosophical tone to your day. Mars, your traditional ruler, in Cancer in the same 9th house adds drive to explore, learn and perhaps challenge certain beliefs. The Sun and retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 11th focus your mind on friendships, networks and long-term plans. Today’s energies combine to ask: how can you let your true passions shape the direction you’re heading?

💼 Career: With a 5th-house Moon, you’re supported in any work that involves originality, performance, design, teaching or mentoring. You may feel ready to take a slightly braver stance in a meeting, offering a perspective that others haven’t voiced. Virgo in your 11th encourages you to revisit group commitments, community projects or team roles: are you actually using your talents there, or just filling gaps? It could be a day for sketching out a new project, pitch, or long-term creative venture that aligns better with what genuinely excites you.

❤️ Love: Romance today leans toward soulful play rather than heavy processing. If partnered, making space for shared fun—creative activities, games, time with children, or revisiting an old shared interest—can warm the bond. Deeper topics about purpose and future directions may arise naturally from relaxed conversation. If single, your magnetism is heightened when you’re absorbed in what you love doing. You may attract attention through hobbies, creative spaces or social circles that reflect your true interests, not just casual mingling.

💰 Money: The 5th house is also linked to speculative ventures and discretionary spending. Pisces Moon here advises approaching risk with caution and intuition combined: avoid impulsive gambles, but don’t ignore a quietly persistent idea that feels aligned and well-researched. Virgo in your 11th points to financial connections with groups—dues, shared investments, crowdfunded projects. Reassessing one collaborative financial commitment could free resources for a creative or educational pursuit that feels more meaningful.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to enjoy what you’re naturally good at without immediately turning it into a burden or obligation.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The moment you recognise that your joy is not a distraction but a guidepost, your next steps become clearer than any external advice.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

This creates a deeply introspective undercurrent, even if your outer life seems busy. The Sun and retrograde Mercury in Virgo remain at the top of your chart in the 10th, keeping career questions active. Today’s sky highlights the tension and potential harmony between public duties and private needs.

💼 Career: With Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 10th, you may still be reviewing roles, responsibilities, or your larger professional direction. The Pisces Moon in your 4th suggests that decisions made purely from ambition could feel hollow now; you need your choices to sit well in your chest, not just look good on paper. You might benefit from working from home if possible, or from creating a more soothing atmosphere in your workspace. Conversations with family or trusted confidants could offer perspective on a career decision you’ve been circling.

Discussions about living arrangements, family plans or how you each recharge could be significant. If single, you might feel less drawn to socialising and more to cultivating inner peace, but someone from your past or from your family’s circle could resurface in your thoughts or messages. Notice what that stirs up about what you truly want in a home life.

💰 Money: Jupiter’s presence in your 8th keeps themes of shared resources, debts and long-term planning in the background. Today’s Moon in the 4th points toward real estate, household expenses and family financial patterns. You may decide to review rent, mortgage, utilities or support to relatives, aiming for arrangements that feel both sustainable and fair. Sun–Mercury in your 10th can also highlight negotiations around salary or benefits; consider how any changes would impact your home base.

🧘 Advice: Before you say yes to another responsibility, check in with the part of you that simply wants to feel at home in your own life.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The quiet decision you make about your living or emotional environment today may support your ambitions far more than another push of effort.
capricorn:

Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 9th favour revisiting training, contracts involving foreign entities, or strategic plans; you may identify a belief or assumption about your career path that needs updating.

pisces:
